title: Practice 2: Prefixes on verbs of motion

blocks.text: Sentences and their English: Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR). Words, meanings and how each word is built: the English Wiktionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Девочка **обо**шла лужу. (The little girl walked around the puddle.) What does обо- add here?
options: Movement behind an object; stopping off on the way
Intended arrival, signals presence of the agent at a location as a result of motion
Movement upwards
Movement around an object or involving a consecutive number of objects, circling, covering a whole place
exercises.why: The English Wikipedia's table of prefixed motion verbs: о-, об-, обо- — Movement around an object or involving a consecutive number of objects, circling, covering a whole place.

exercises.q: Туча **на**ползла на солнце. (A cloud crept onto the sun.) What does на- add here?
options: Beginning of multidirectional movement
Movement inwards across a threshold, entering
Movement onto the surface of an object
Withdrawal a short distance away
exercises.why: The English Wikipedia's table of prefixed motion verbs: на- — Movement onto the surface of an object.

exercises.q: Чтобы заниматься, студентка **с**несла все учебники из других комнат на письменный стол. (In order to study, the student brought all her textbooks from other rooms to her desk.) What does с- add here?
options: Prolonged multidirectional movement
Movement behind an object; stopping off on the way
Movement across, through, or past something
Convergent movement from various directions towards one center
exercises.why: The English Wikipedia's table of prefixed motion verbs: с-, со- (+сь, +ся) — Convergent movement from various directions towards one center.

exercises.q: Дед Мороз **раз**нёс подарки по домам. (Grandfather Frost brought the gifts to the (various) houses.) What does раз- add here?
options: Movement downwards
Divergent movement in various directions from one center
Movement around an object or involving a consecutive number of objects, circling, covering a whole place
Prolonged multidirectional movement
exercises.why: The English Wikipedia's table of prefixed motion verbs: раз-, разо-, рас- (+сь, +ся) — Divergent movement in various directions from one center.

exercises.q: Я **по**шла в университет. (I went to the university.) What does по- add here?
options: Movement around an object or involving a consecutive number of objects, circling, covering a whole place
Movement onto the surface of an object
Beginning of unidirectional movement
Movement out of something across a threshold, exiting
exercises.why: The English Wikipedia's table of prefixed motion verbs: по- — Beginning of unidirectional movement.

exercises.q: Она **за**бегала по комнате. (She started running around the room.) What does за- add here?
options: Reaching a limit or destination
Movement inwards across a threshold, entering
Movement downwards
Beginning of multidirectional movement
exercises.why: The English Wikipedia's table of prefixed motion verbs: за- — Beginning of multidirectional movement.

exercises.q: Мы **про**ходили по лесу весь день. (We walked around the woods all day.) What does про- add here?
options: Prolonged multidirectional movement
Convergent movement from various directions towards one center
Divergent movement in various directions from one center
Movement inwards across a threshold, entering
exercises.why: The English Wikipedia's table of prefixed motion verbs: про- — Prolonged multidirectional movement.

exercises.q: Она задумчиво **по**ходила по квартире и наконец решила уйти. (She walked around the apartment pensively and finally decided to leave.) What does по- add here?
options: Divergent movement in various directions from one center
Movement upwards
Completed semelfactive movement in opposite directions, there and back.
Slow and measured multidirectional movement
exercises.why: The English Wikipedia's table of prefixed motion verbs: по- — Slow and measured multidirectional movement.

exercises.q: Я **с**ходил в аптеку за лекарством и лёг спать. (I went to the pharmacy for medicine and went to bed.) What does с- add here?
options: Movement around an object or involving a consecutive number of objects, circling, covering a whole place
Movement across, from one point to another; through
Movement inwards across a threshold, entering
Completed semelfactive movement in opposite directions, there and back.
exercises.why: The English Wikipedia's table of prefixed motion verbs: с- — Completed semelfactive movement in opposite directions, there and back..
